data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-B-N’ which means 'father'. The name Abnus is a title given to the father of a prophet or a revered spiritual figure. In Islamic history, there are several figures with this name, including the father of Prophet Musa (Moses) and Prophet Yunus (Jonah). The name Abnus carries the meaning “Father of a prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abnus usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
